verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that segments exist as email recipient or exclusion targets. It also shows a segment can be generated from contacts excluded from a send. Neither describes building segments from profile attributes, tags, or behavioral events, or segments updating live as data changes. These are adjacent features of the email editor, not the segmentation capability itself.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audience segments from profile attributes, tags, and behavioral events, and they stay live as data changes
